MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL: normal volatility at 33.0% and mixed breadth, with 4/8 sectors positive. Signals are balanced; leadership is concentrated rather than broad-based.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +14.32%), ABOVE TREND; Banking & Finance follows (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +4.34%), ABOVE TREND. Heavy Industry and Construction & REIT are in RECOVERY, with positive weekly returns but negative monthly returns.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy & Chemicals (1W: -0.20% | 1M: -14.94%), Holding & Investment (-0.35% | -3.69%) and Retail & Food (-0.37% | -10.21%) are BELOW TREND. Technology & Telecom is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.07% | 1M: +4.64%).

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +19.31%) and FROTO (1W: +8.11% | 1M: +0.96%) are ABOVE TREND; CCOLA (1W: +8.40% | 1M: -8.97%), EKGYO (1W: +7.79% | 1M: -4.42%) and TUPRS (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -7.45%) are in RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
TRMET (1W: -0.73% | 1M: -19.84%), AEFES (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -10.32%), ARCLK (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -11.29%), SASA (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -13.98%) and GUBRF (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -30.14%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +19.31%) leads weekly momentum, followed by CCOLA (1W: +8.40% | 1M: -8.97%) in RECOVERY. FROTO (1W: +8.11% | 1M: +0.96%) is ABOVE TREND, while EKGYO (1W: +7.79% | 1M: -4.42%) and TUPRS (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -7.45%) are in RECOVERY.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Sector breadth is constructive: Banking & Finance is ABOVE TREND, up 5.39% weekly and 4.34% monthly. GARAN (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +16.22%) is ABOVE TREND; AKBNK (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +1.96%), ISCTR (1W: +4.44% | 1M: +4.44%) and YKBNK (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +4.06%) are also ABOVE TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is in RECOVERY at +4.97% weekly, despite a -9.36% monthly return. FROTO (1W: +8.11% | 1M: +0.96%) is ABOVE TREND; EREGL (1W: +4.09% | 1M: -13.96%), TOASO (1W: +6.87% | 1M: -8.64%) and ASELS (1W: +4.79% | 1M: -1.71%) are in RECOVERY.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector remains BELOW TREND, down 0.20% weekly and 14.94% monthly, though TUPRS (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -7.45%) and SISE (1W: +1.69% | 1M: -4.91%) are in RECOVERY. SASA (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -13.98%) and GUBRF (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -30.14%) remain BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a balanced, selective stance consistent with the NEUTRAL regime; favor confirmed strength while avoiding broad exposure to persistent laggards. Require improving breadth before adding risk materially.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
PGSUS (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +19.31%) and GARAN (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +16.22%) offer confirmed momentum, both ABOVE TREND. Track THYAO (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +11.44%) as another ABOVE TREND leader, and watch FROTO (1W: +8.11% | 1M: +0.96%) for follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Transportation and Banking & Finance for continuation of their ABOVE TREND leadership. Watch Heavy Industry for recovery durability and Energy & Chemicals for signs of breadth stabilization.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 index levels are supplied, so specific support or resistance levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a volatility shift from the 33.0% normal range and a change in sector breadth from 4/8 positive.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market is NEUTRAL, with normal volatility and mixed breadth; Transportation and Banking & Finance lead, while Energy & Chemicals and Retail & Food remain weak. PGSUS and GARAN show confirmed strength, but rebounds across several other leaders remain recoveries rather than established monthly uptrends.
